newsitem.title: JAPAN: NTT, Asian telecom firms to form multimedia forum.
newsitem.headline: NTT, Asian telecom firms to form multimedia forum.

text.p: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp and 12 other Asian telecommunications firms will form a group later this year to develop multimedia applications and services, NTT president Junichiro Miyazu said on Wednesday.
He said the firms, from eight Asian countries, would form the Asian Multimedia Forum by the middle of this year.
He said the aim of the forum would be to share information and conduct experiments. It would also be open to companies in other areas.

The members include Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd, PT Indonesian Satellite Corp, Korea Telecom, Telekom Malaysia Bhd, Smart Communications Inc of the Philippines, Singapore Telecommunications Ltd and the Communications Authority of Thailand.
Asked if NTT's intention was to exert its influence on Asian firms and establish a de facto standard, Miyazu said: "Business is not the group's top priority."
